thread:
sam_support: Heads up — customer (tenant: acme-inc) reporting SSE session abort mid-stream when switching from corp VPN -> phone hotspot. They see a truncated JSON chunk and were charged for the partial output. Attaching customer logs shortly.

elaine_mobile: Pasting client log excerpt from them: 
`Error: read ECONNRESET at Socket._onStreamRead (internal/stream_base_commons.js:...)` then `reconnect attempt -> 401` about 2–3s after the network route change. iOS 16.5, Safari.

noah_sre: Thanks — that pattern usually points to NAT rebind / TCP RST on the client path plus token rotation during reconnect. Two things to grab: a pcap/tcpdump around the switch and the client Authorization timing. Can you get exact timestamps? I'll check edge logs for the tenant.

sam_support: Repro steps the customer provided:
1) Start SSE to `/v1/stream` with `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
2) With stream active toggle VPN off, enable phone hotspot
3) Client receives partial JSON then connection closes; retry sometimes yields 401.
They shared this curl as minimal repro:
```bash
curl -v -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=redwood-lite"
```

tara_engineer: On our side: we keep the HTTP/1.1 connection open and expect clients to reconnect. Two likely failure modes:
- Token rotation TTL < client retry window -> reconnect gets rejected with 401
- Edge proxy/NAT treats the rebind as RST and upstream sees abrupt close, leaving partial chunk at client side
Short-term mitigations: recommend SSE comment heartbeats (`: keepalive\n\n`) or a small initial confirmation chunk so customer sees at least one server-sent event before long generation. Also recommend client include fresh token on every reconnect.

noah_sre: I'll query edge logs for connection resets for acme-inc around the reported times (today ~2025-11-23T15:26:10Z +/- 1m). metrics-bot, can you pull midstream disconnect + 401 counts for that tenant for last 24h?

metrics-bot: metrics-bot: pulled counts for tenant `acme-inc` — 14 midstream disconnects with follow-up 401 within 60s in last 24h. Proxy node 10.2.3.4 shows `conn_reset` spikes aligned with client region handoffs. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/tenants/acme-inc/streams?range=24h :eyes: 

elaine_mobile: Customer also says if they flip 'Use Cellular' before disabling VPN sometimes the stream survives. So ordering/timing matters. They'll try to capture a pcap and full app logs.

sam_support: Suggested workaround to share with customer now:
- add SSE comment heartbeats (every 10s) to avoid silent EOFs being mistaken for complete responses
- on reconnect, always fetch a fresh token and include it in Authorization header (don't reuse stale cached tokens)
- increase client TCP keepalive/shorten token rotation window awareness in app
We'll also propose server step: emit very short JSON ack as first chunk for long-running generations so partial-charge risk is reduced.

tara_engineer: I'll open an infra ticket to investigate NAT rebind behavior on that proxy and to add a docs note about SSE heartbeats + best-practice reconnect flow. Ticket INF-2026-331 created. I'll also propose a small server change to return an explicit reconnect hint (e.g., `session-resumed` body) when a reconnect resumes an interrupted session.

noah_sre: If customer can share pcap I can correlate the connection id and replay to see exactly where RST originates. Sam — recommend P2 for now unless billing impact escalates.

sam_support: :thumbsup: Marking P2 pending pcap. I'll follow up with customer asking for the pcap, full logs, and the exact token rotation timing. Keeping thread open and will update once we have artifacts.
